doc.p: Scores: underlined text, struck through, scored over and a line three points below the placement path.
Without the spaces: only the words are scored here, and the spaces between them are left open.
A color change ends a score: black then red then black again.
A field in a score: name Smith ends here, the field scored over its whole width.
A long score breaks with its line: this underlined passage is long enough that it runs on into the next line and is scored on both lines of the paragraph without a gap.
A paragraph with a background color: the color lies under every line of it, from its start indent to its end indent, as high as the line is.
